description_en: Calls the UpdateVirtualBorderBandwidth operation to update the bandwidth throttling for both the upstream and downstream routing directions on a Virtual Border Router (VBR)
description_zh: 调用UpdateVirtualBorderBandwidth接口更新边界路由器上下云双方向的带宽限速
kebab_example: aliyun vpc update-virtual-border-bandwidth --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --virtual-border-router-id vbr-bp15zckdt37pq720000 --bandwidth 2 --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-00160000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateVirtualBorderBandwidth

parameters.description_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** of each API request is different.
